newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Banks resigns from cabinet - NZPA.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Banks resigns from cabinet - NZPA.

text.p: Whangarei MP John Banks on Friday announced his resignation from New Zealand's cabinet, the New Zealand Press Association reported.
Banks was minister of tourism, sport and local government and civil defence in National's caretaker government.
In a statement he said he was now attracted to the "forefront of social issues that affect New Zealand".
"I can only be properly engaged in this if I am independent of cabinet restraints," Banks said.
"I am also going to pursue other interests. These include broadcasting. I enjoy communicating with people and feel I can sharpen the edge of political debate through this medium."
Banks said the price of being a minister was almost a total commitment of time and effort and he now wanted to spend time with his family.
